name: forever-happy-town
description:
About This Game

Well, well, well.. Well.

You messed up the town again, didn't you?

A PvE multiplayer shooter where a prophecy of eight endless nights is rapidly approaching, a fresh cohort of sentinels have recently been recruited, are you good enough to keep the town forever happy? You'd better be, else a herd of lovely rabbits will require rapid relocation.

  • Defend the town!

  • Hook everything in sight!

  • Maul the mysterious mighty monsters!

  • Unlock and upgrade your weaponry!

  • Battle over the top score with your ferocious friends!!
